title: BACKND Base post / mailbox (UPost)
summary: Mailbox system using the current UPost API: fetch posts by kind (administrator, rank, coupon, user, webshop), get one or all, receive/claim, send, and delete. UPost pages oldest-receivable-first and replaces the legacy Social.Post (which only read the latest 100).
capabilities: route mailbox questions to UPost by post kind
explain UPost paging (oldest-first, accumulates across calls)
distinguish console posts from user posts
flag legacy Social.Post limitations vs UPost
prerequisites: SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
common_pitfalls: Using legacy Social.Post (latest-100 only) instead of UPost
Expecting all posts on the first UPost call (it accumulates across calls)
verification_required_for: exact UPost method names and PostType values
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating mailbox code.
Prefer UPost over legacy Social.Post; confirm PostType and paging upstream.
public_notes: UPost is the current mailbox API; Social.Post is legacy (latest-100 only).
UPost paging is oldest-first and accumulates across calls.
